description:
VAC Motorsports, my first co-op from Drexel University, offered a unique experience working in a race car garage rather than a traditional office setting. I collaborated with a team of race mechanics, machinists, automotive engineers, and race drivers, learning the immense value of teamwork and trust. As a web developer, I updated the company's eCommerce website, enhancing over 10,000 SKU product pages and integrating advanced eCommerce functionalities to boost sales. I also captured and edited product photos, created branding materials using Photoshop, produced social media videos, and provided facility tours for walk-in customers. 
 Beyond my web development duties, I was entrusted with a significant marketing budget, allowing me to run social media campaigns and delve into the potential of Facebook and Google ads. This role introduced me to the power of data-driven marketing and the importance of adaptability, as I made myself useful in every department of the company. My time at VAC Motorsports was instrumental in developing my skills in web development, digital marketing, content creation, and customer service, preparing me for diverse professional challenges.

bullets.bullet: Implemented strategic SEO techniques in HTML and JavaScript boosting website traffic by 60%.
Automated Google Analytics reporting with Python, slashing daily analysis time from 1 hour to seconds. Improved efficiency for the sales team
Integrated Inuit QuickBooks and Nexternal e-Commerce on ReactJS, reducing weekly accounting time by over 15 hours.
Lead digital marketing campaign using Google Ads and Facebook Business Manager generating 8,500+ leads

description:
Due to my exceptional performance during the COVID-19 pandemic, I was invited back for a third co-op at Tridiuum, this time joining the Customer Success team as a UI/UX researcher. In this role, I collaborated with multiple external teams to understand their requirements and build custom dashboards. For the product team, I designed a patient retention dashboard measuring metrics such as time on platform, time on page, user journey, and PES scores. I also redesigned many of the guides I initially created, using Figma to create mockups and implementing the designs after obtaining team approval.
During this stint, my manager Angela Brown left her role as product manager, and I was appointed interim product manager until the end of my co-op. This was my first leadership role, where I led a small team to handle requests from various departments within the company. As a manager, I developed a Salesforce knowledge base-powered chatbot, significantly reducing the number of customer tickets. Additionally, I partnered with an animation studio to develop training guides, further enhancing user understanding of our product.

bullets.bullet: Designed and developed interactive dashboards utilizing ReactJS & D3.js, analyzing over 1 million user journeys boosting user engagement by 20%.
Conducted user research and usability testing to inform decisions and iterate design, achieving a 90% adoption rate for 18,000+ users.
Created a Salesforce-powered chatbot and partnered with an animation studio for tutorial videos, leading to a 70% decrease in support tickets.
Redesigned user-centric onbarding guides with Figma, JavaScript & CSS, improving user experience and increasing onboarding efficiency by 42%.

description:
From 2020 to 2021, I worked at Tridiuum, a mental healthcare company focused on patient care and connecting patients with the right providers. This was my second co-op from Drexel University, and it occurred during the global pandemic. At Tridiuum, I truly appreciated the importance of aligning with the company's vision. My work directly or indirectly contributed to improving people's lives during a stressful time. This role also heightened my awareness of my own mental health, and my coworkers provided invaluable support and insight into the world of mental healthcare.
As part of the customer success team and the sole developer in the team, I was responsible for creating training and onboarding guides for users and doctors on our platform. Given the complexity of our healthcare product and the need to comply with numerous regulations, this was a challenging task. With my team’s support, I developed over 150 onboarding guides, significantly improving the onboarding completion rate and user retention. Additionally, I was tasked with developing dashboards to help our design team understand user behavior across the platform, enhancing our ability to meet user needs effectively.

bullets.bullet: Designed user-facing onboarding guides using React, CSS, and Pendo, resulting in an 80% increase in user engagement
Integrated 150+ SaaS clients, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless user experience and adoption of new features.
Built 20+ data abstraction tools with D3.js, and React, improving user research and retention strategies.
Collaborated with product managers and designers to uphold accessibility best practices utilising Jest framework for unit and integration testing

description: I began working at Focus Print Solutions as a graphic designer in 9th grade, and I formally joined the team as a full-time member immediately after graduation. Initially, I created assets for websites and other media requirements, but I gradually advanced to a designer role. As a designer, I communicated with various clients to understand their needs and requirements, developing product packaging, logos, informational materials, and more. My ability to deliver high-quality designs and effectively collaborate with clients has allowed me to continue working as a freelancer for the company to this day.

bullets.bullet: Designed graphics for over 30 small businesses and non-profit organizations.
Created logos, vectors, and web assets for local print media and websites
Provided two local magazines and a news outlet with graphic and stationary.
